extracted.name: Grilled Soy-Sesame Asparagus
extracted.description: This asparagus pairs especially well with Asian types of grilled foods, such as kebabs or satays.
instruction_lines: In a bowl, mix sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, and brown sugar. Place asparagus in the bowl, and toss to coat.
Lightly oil a fine-mesh grill grate. Place asparagus on grate, and cook 8 minutes, until tender but firm. Garnish with sesame seeds to serve.
